components.name: Secondary Report Action
components.description: Supporting navigation to a report or secondary source.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #44403c; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #a8a29e; color: #292524; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #fafaf9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact register search with an emerald evidence-workflow focus state.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="Søk i 40 profiler" aria-label="Søk i prosjektregisteret">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 260px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #0c0a09; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: #a8a29e; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: #059669; outline: 2px solid #a7f3d0; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The incumbent two-line sidebar item in its active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: block; border-radius: 8px; background: #f5f5f4; color: #1c1917; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-active strong { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-active span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: #78716c; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #e7e5e4; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Neutral Status Chip
components.description: Compact metadata or status that stays legible without relying on color.
components.css: .ds-chip-neutral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f5f5f4; color: #78716c; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 16px; }

components.name: Internal Gate Banner
components.description: An explicit internal-use, rights, or human-review boundary.
components.html: INTERN ARBEIDSFLATEKandidater og eierpåstander er ikke uavhengig verifisert.

components.name: Canonical Card
components.description: A reusable white working surface for a bounded evidence unit.
components.html:
Kildestatus

Vis styrke, avgrensning og neste kontrollpunkt sammen.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; border: 1px solid rgb(231 229 228 / 0.8); border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; padding: 20px; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(28 25 23 / 0.03); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #44403c; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #d6d3d1; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Coverage Cell
components.description: A selectable geography cell that exposes coverage count and semantic status before rank.
components.css: .ds-coverage-cell { min-height: 96px; width: 150px; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; border-radius: 12px; background: #ecfdf5; color: #022c22; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-coverage-cell span { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; } .ds-coverage-cell strong { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 32px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-coverage-cell small { display: block; color: #065f46; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-coverage-cell:hover { border-color: #059669; } .ds-coverage-cell:active, .ds-coverage-cell[aria-pressed='true'] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0c0a09, 0 0 0 4px #ffffff; } .ds-coverage-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Score
components.description: Five separate sky segments plus a numeric label for independently readable evidence strength.
components.css: .ds-evidence-score { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #44403c; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-score span, .ds-evidence-score i { display: block; width: 16px; height: 6px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-evidence-score span { background: #0284c7; } .ds-evidence-score i { background: #e7e5e4; } .ds-evidence-score strong { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The Evidence Field treats the interface as a calm operational landscape: stone surfaces establish the working ground, while restrained emerald, sky, amber, and rose signals reveal strategic relevance, evidence strength, gates, and gaps. It is dense enough for research work but never theatrical; hierarchy comes from typography, tonal grouping, and compact evidence structures.

The interface stays visibly internal and provenance-aware. Coverage leads, ranking never masquerades as certainty, and every summary should move the reader toward a source, the canonical completion register, or an explicit next gate rather than toward an unsupported verdict.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, light stone workspace with white working surfaces.
Compact, highly legible tables, chips, and status rails.
Emerald strategic signal kept separate from sky evidence signal.
Amber human, rights, and publication gates; rose for explicit gaps or negative states.
Read-only navigation that makes uncertainty and provenance actionable.

rules.name: The Signal Separation Rule
rules.body: Emerald expresses strategic priority or action, sky expresses evidence, amber expresses a gate, and rose expresses an explicit gap; never collapse those meanings into one score or color.

rules.name: The Color Never Proves Rule
rules.body: Every color-coded state must retain a text or numeric label, because evidence status cannot depend on hue recognition.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight, spacing, and compact numerals before increasing type size; this is a research cockpit, not a marketing page.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not stack decorative shadows; use borders and tonal surfaces first, and reserve the soft shadow for a reusable card that needs gentle separation.

rules.name: The Two-Axis Verdict Rule
rules.body: Strategic priority and evidence strength must remain separate visual variables; ranking may order attention, but it must never imply independent verification.

dos: Do lead with Nordic and thematic coverage before showing rank.
Do keep source counts, evidence strength, ownership affiliation, rights limits, and next gates visible and separately labelled.
Do use the completion register as the canonical destination for completion, human, rights, source, and publication gates.
Do preserve compact tables, tabular numerals, semantic headings, visible focus, and responsive stacking.
Do finish a new surface with review, a clear verdict, and updated design documentation.
donts: Don't use emerald strategic priority as a proxy for sky evidence strength.
Don't present candidates, owner-affiliated claims, or project reporting as independently verified findings.
Don't imply that a read-only projection promotes a candidate, imports data, publishes externally, or closes a gate.
Don't hide unknown, thin, or blocked coverage behind completeness language or a zero without context.
Don't introduce a separate visual identity, ornamental gradients, oversized marketing type, or decorative card stacks into the incumbent stone system.
